models.transport_note: Claude Code 2.1.293+ is required. The default effort is medium on both the API and Claude Code. The haiku alias resolves to Haiku 5.5 on the Anthropic API (from Claude Code 2.1.293) and to Haiku 4.5 on other providers, so the Orca lane sends the exact ID. Public facts do not prove this account's included usage or model access.

pricing.note: Priced by prompt length: a request whose prompt is over 100,000 tokens pays the tier prices, and a prompt of exactly 100,000 tokens pays the base prices. Prompt length counts all input tokens, including cache reads and cache writes, and each request is priced on its own. Cache writes have two durations in each tier: $0.125/MTok (5-minute) and $0.20/MTok (1-hour) up to the threshold, $0.625/MTok and $1/MTok over it. The single cache_write field cannot safely represent both durations, so it is null in both tiers.
Context cache storage and tools are separate charges; rates change 2027-01-01.

models.effort_note: The model page lists xhigh, but the reasoning guide says grok-4.5 treats xhigh as high, and its release note and grok CLI 1.0.46 list low/medium/high only; xhigh stays excluded.
